name: Sikalastic-888 Hybrid
paste:
SIKALASTIC®-888 HYBRID: SPECIFICATION CLAUSE SET

Source: Sikalastic®-888 Hybrid, April 2023, Version 01.03 (https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/x/sikalastic-888-hybrid.pdf)
Draft for specifier review. Wording, values and standards are quoted from that data sheet; where it is silent the clause says 'Refer to manufacturer.' Confirm the current edition before issue.

1 SCOPE
1.1 Work included. Provide Sikalastic®-888 Hybrid where documented, installed or applied in accordance with this clause and the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (April 2023, Version 01.03).
1.2 Product description.
    - Sikalastic®-888 Hybrid is a two component, elastic, 100% solids, very fast curing polyurethane/polyurea hybrid liquid applied membrane with moderate chemical resistance.
    - Sikalastic®-888 Hybrid is suitable for use in hot and tropical climatic conditions.
1.3 Intended uses stated by the manufacturer. Sikalastic®-888 Hybrid is ideal for the following applications:
1.4 Intended uses stated by the manufacturer - On Concrete.
    - Waterproofing on concrete bridge decks, membrane underneath hot rolled asphalt
    - Waterproofing for submersed structures
    - Waterproofing for cut and cover structures
    - Waterproofing on walkways and balconies
    - Waterproofing on floors and car park decks
    - Water retaining structures in power plants Tank, bund and pit lining in fresh water areas of sewage and waste water treatment plants
1.5 Intended uses stated by the manufacturer - On Steel.
    - Truck bed lining

2 MATERIALS
2.1 Product. Sikalastic®-888 Hybrid
    - Product type as printed on the data sheet: Two component solvent free 100% solids Polyurethane/Polyurea Hybrid membrane
    - Supplier as printed on the data sheet: Sika Australia Pty Limited, ABN 12 001 342 329, aus.sika.com, Tel: 1300 22 33 48
2.2 Approvals / certificates.
    - AS/ NZS 4020:2018 Potable water approved (Natural colour only)
    - AS4654.1- 2012 Waterproofing membranes for external above-ground use
2.3 Standards and test methods cited in the data sheet. Cited as written in the data sheet. A citation is not a statement that the product complies with it; conformity is stated only where the data sheet says so (see the approvals clause and the statements quoted in the other clauses).
    - AS/ NZS 4020:2018: listed under approvals, certificates or standards. Where: Approvals / Certificates (p.1).
    - AS4654.1- 2012: listed under approvals, certificates or standards. Where: Approvals / Certificates (p.1).
    - AS1683.15: cited with a stated property or value. Where: Product Information > Shore A hardness (p.2).
    - AS1683.11: cited with a stated property or value. Where: Product Information > Tensile strength (p.2).
    - AS4654.1-2012: cited with a stated property or value. Where: Product Information > Tensile strain at break (p.2).
    - AS1683.12: cited with a stated property or value. Where: Product Information > Tear strength (p.2).
2.4 Characteristics stated by the manufacturer.
    - Very fast reactivity and curing time
    - Almost immediate return-to-service time
    - Applicable in temperatures from -10 °C to +50 °C
    - Performs in constant dry temperatures from -30 °C to +100 °C
    - Excellent crack bridging properties
    - Moderate chemical resistance
    - Good abrasion resistance
    - Not UV resistant
2.5 Composition, appearance and supply.
    - Composition: Polyurethane/ Polyurea Hybrid
    - Colour: Grey; White (MTO); Blue (MTO); Natural (MTO)- For potable water applications
    - Density: Part A: 1.10kg @ 25°C; Part B: 1.02kg @ 25°C
    - Viscosity: Part A: 800 (cps @ 25°C); Part B: 170 (cps @ 25°C)
2.6 Properties stated by the manufacturer.
    - Shore A hardness: 90 (AS1683.15)
    - Tensile strength: 14 (AS1683.11)
    - Tensile strain at break: 255% Elongation at break; Class II membrane (AS4654.1-2012 Appendix A)
    - Tear strength: 42 kN/m (AS1683.12- Angle tear strength)
    - Service temperature: -30°C to +100°C
2.7 System structure. CONCRETE SUBSTRATE APPLICATIONS:
    - Sikalastic 100 EP Primer must be used as the primer for potable water applications.
    - If Sikalastic 100 EP Primer/Sikafloor 160 is being overcoated with Sikalastic®-888 Hybrid within 24 hours of application, sand broadcasting is not required.
    - Please note for substrates containing moisture (up to 6%) we suggest substituting primer for Sikalastic Moisture Seal.
    - For adhesion to other substrates than concrete please contact Sika Technical for advice.
    | Coating System | Product | Consumption |
    | Primer Coat | Sikalastic 100 EP | 0.2-0.4kg/m² (depend- |
    | Primer/ Sikafloor 160 | ing on substrate poros- |
    | (epoxy primer) | ity) |
    | Primer Broadcast | 0.3-0.8mm kiln dried | 1.0-1.5kg/m² |
    | quartz sand |
    | Membrane Coat | Sikalastic®-888 Hybrid | approx. 1.02kg/m²/mm |
    (System build-up table as printed; a cell that wraps appears over several rows. Refer to the data sheet (page 2) for the layout.)
2.8 Mixing ratio. Part A : Part B = 1:1 volume
2.9 Consumption. approx. 1.02kg/m²/mm
2.10 Layer thickness. >2mm :Typical waterproofing applications- Podiums,balconies,roof tops etc; >3mm: Tanking/immersed applications; Please consult Sika Technical for film thickness of all other applications
2.11 Ambient air temperature. -20°C ~ +50°C
2.12 Relative air humidity. < 85%
2.13 Substrate temperature. +1°C ~ +50°C; ≥ 3°C above dew point, beware of condensation
2.14 Curing time. 6 days at 25°C
2.15 Waiting time to overcoating. 2-6min depending on temperature. Note: Do not exceed 2 hour overcoat window
2.16 Drying time. 10min at 25°C
2.17 Packaging, shelf life and storage.
    - Packaging: Part A: 228kg Part B: 206kg (434kg kit); Part A: 23kg Part B: 20kg (43kg kit) **Grey only**
    - Shelf life: 12 months from date of production
    - Storage conditions: The packaging must be stored properly in original, unopened and undamaged sealed packaging, in dry and cool conditions protected from direct sunlight.

3 SUBSTRATE PREPARATION
3.1 Substrate preparation. Refer to manufacturer. The data sheet reviewed (April 2023, Version 01.03) states no substrate preparation requirements.

4 APPLICATION
4.1 Application. Refer to manufacturer. The data sheet reviewed (April 2023, Version 01.03) states no application requirements.

5 QUALITY CONTROL AND TESTING
5.1 Hold point. Before each application, confirm the site conditions with the manufacturer. HOLD POINT: do not proceed until the Superintendent has released the hold point.
5.2 Conditions to be verified. Refer to manufacturer. The data sheet reviewed (April 2023, Version 01.03) lists no application condition limits.
5.3 Basis of the stated values. All technical data stated in this Product Data Sheet are based on laboratory tests. Actual measured data may vary due to circumstances beyond our control.
5.4 Other tests. For any test method, sampling frequency or acceptance criterion not stated in this clause: refer to manufacturer and the project specification.

6 WARRANTY AND DOCUMENTATION
6.1 Documents to be obtained and submitted. Obtain the current issue of each document before ordering and submit it with the product submission. Documents are listed as published on the manufacturer's website.
    - Product Data Sheet: Sikalastic®-888 Hybrid, April 2023, Version 01.03, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/x/sikalastic-888-hybrid.pdf
    - Safety Data Sheet: SDS Sikalastic®-888 Hybrid Part B, version 03/02/2026, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/b/sds-sikalastic-888hybridpartb.pdf
6.2 Ecology, health and safety. For information and advice on the safe handling, storage and disposal of chemical products, users shall refer to the most recent Safety Data Sheet (SDS) ntaining physical, ecological, toxicological and other safety-related data.
6.3 Warranty. Obtain any product or installation warranty in writing from the manufacturer or its authorised applicator and file it with the project records. Warranty terms: refer to manufacturer.
    - Legal notes: In practice, the differences in materials, substrates and actual site conditions are such that no warranty in respect of merchantability or of fitness for a particular purpose, nor any liability arising out of any legal relationship whatsoever, can be inferred either from this information, or from any written recommendations, or from any other advice offered.
6.4 Local restrictions. Please note that as a result of specific local regulations the declared data for this product may vary from country to country. Please consult the local Product Data Sheet for the exact product data.
6.5 Application records. Record the product name, batch numbers, dates, areas treated and the conditions measured under clause 5.1, and include the records in the project documentation.
